videos.title: Teleshopping
videos.description: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: The trial of accused paedophile Ben Perkins gets underway as his brother DC Terry Perkins is called as a witness. Unfortunately, it looks like the trial will collapse when Terry cracks.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Smithy is taking a risk by meeting up with a gangster's wife. Meanwhile, PC Tony Stamp is having no luck with women and tries his hand at internet dating.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: DS Phil Hunter inadvertently asks Kate to marry him, Gina Gold returns to work but relies on June Ackland to oversee the relief, and DC Gary Best is shot in the back while investigating a stolen goods scam.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Gina Gold is found unconscious on her bathroom floor. Tony Stamp hires an escort for Honey's birthday party - who turns out to be Amber Johannsen.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Ian Barratt receives photographs of Adam Okaro smoking a spliff with Isaac Collins, Adam resigns - but his life is in grave danger. Elsewhere, Rochelle and Dan are caught during a steamy liaison in her office. Plus, Tony dumps Amber at a works party, and Jack questions Neil about his relationship with Susie Sim.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: A teacher who has been assaulted by one of her pupils reluctantly agrees to press charges. Plus, DC Ramani De Costa is devastated to discover DC Terry Perkins' affair with his sister-in-law. Meanwhile, Adam Okaro is on leave and DCI Jack Meadows steps in as acting superintendent. Then elsewhere, Sheelagh fears that her relationship with Gabriel may be coming to an end.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Jack Meadows arrests his son for possession of cocaine and asks Neil Manson and Terry Perkins to interview him. Plus, Benjamin's prints match those from an assault case, and Jack realises that his son is in deep trouble. Meanwhile, Ramani De Costa and Samantha Nixon investigate the disappearance of a young nurse, and Peter Baxter turns up at Sun Hill.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: A dangerous driver in a pick-up truck causes carnage when his vehicle rolls over and the HART team are called to free him and his passenger from the wreckage.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: A hitman with links to a drugs gang guns down two men in a supermarket car park. Later, a teenage dare leads to a massive rescue operation after a boy vanishes in the water.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: A truck drives through the barrier of a busy motorway and hits a BMW head-on. The team join a delicate rescue operation to persuade a suicidal man down from a bridge.

videos.description: Reality series following the work of Yorkshire Ambulance Service's Hazardous Area Response Team.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: The team are called to a major fire in a chemicals factory, and paramedics join forces with the firefighters desperately searching for teenagers reported missing in a swollen river.
